scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.test: npm run test:unit -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend && npm test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.format: prettier --write backend frontend e2e package.json README.md docker-compose.yml .prettierrc.json .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check backend frontend e2e package.json README.md docker-compose.yml .prettierrc.json .github
